description: This file defines the QLDBSessionClient class, a PHP client used to interact with Amazon QLDB Session service within the AWS SDK. It extends AwsClient and provides methods to send commands synchronously and asynchronously to the service.

classes.name: QLDBSessionClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon QLDB Session service, extending the base AWS client.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Method to send a command synchronously to the QLDB Session service.

methods.name: sendCommandAsync
methods.description: Method to send a command asynchronously to the QLDB Session service.
